basic_details.job_title: NIT Raipur Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Information Technology, National Institute of Technology Raipur (An Institute of National Importance), has invited applications for a Junior Research Fellow (JRF) on a purely time-bound project sponsored by IBITF, DST, Govt. of India. The fellowship is Rs. 37,000/- per month + HRA for a duration of 4 months. The essential qualification is a Graduate/Post graduate Degree in Computer Sc. & Engg./ Information Technology/ Electronics/ AI/Data Science or equivalent with minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA (out of 10). Applications go by email to [email protected] on or before 27/11/2026

qualification.details: Graduate/Post graduate Degree in Computer Sc. & Engg./ Information Technology/ Electronics/ AI/Data Science or equivalent with minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA (out of 10). The notice does not specify any experience requirement.

vacancy_details.details: The notice prints the number of posts as "Junior Research Fellow – One (02)". Candidates should check the number of posts with the department when they apply.

how_to_apply: Fill in the Application Form for JRF in Information Technology for IBITF Sponsored Project, printed in the notice. It asks for a self-attested photograph, GATE/NET details, personal details, category, research publications, educational qualifications from the 10th standard onwards and employment details.
Attach the relevant mark sheets/documents, age proof, research experience certificate (if any) and CV.
Enclose the list of research publications, if any, as the form asks.
Email the application to [email protected] on or before 27/11/2026.

The notice does not give an email subject line. For any query, contact PI Dr. Chandrashekar Jatoth (Email: [email protected], Mobile: 8897741409) or Co-PI Dr. Rakesh Tripathi (Email: [email protected], Mobile: 9340105510).
Duly filled application form with self-attested photograph
List of research publications, if any
important_instructions: The candidate may be discontinued at any time by giving 2 weeks prior notice if performance is not found satisfactory. Incomplete applications/false information will be summarily rejected. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidature and the appointment. The Institute reserves the right to cancel the post without assigning any reason. If any information in the application is found incorrect/false, or if the candidate does not satisfy the eligibility criteria at a later date, the candidature/appointment is liable to be cancelled, as per the declaration in the form.

content_sections.heading: About NIT Raipur
content_sections.text: National Institute of Technology Raipur is an Institute of National Importance located at G.E. Road, Raipur – 492010 (C.G.). The JRF post is for a research project run at its Department of Information Technology, with Dr. Chandrashekar Jatoth, Associate Professor, as Principal Investigator (PI).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice prints the number of posts as "Junior Research Fellow – One (02)". Candidates should check the number of posts with the department when they apply.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Graduate/Post graduate Degree in Computer Sc. & Engg./ Information Technology/ Electronics/ AI/Data Science or equivalent with minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA (out of 10). The notice does not specify any experience requirement. GATE/NET including Lectureship. Selection through National Level Examinations conducted by the central Govt. Departments and their agencies and Institutions such as ICMR/IIT/IISc/DST/DBT etc. Sound Knowledge in IOT, Blockchain, AI, Deep Learning, Python/R or other programming. Selected candidates will not be permitted to claim any regular/part-time appointments in this Institute or any other organization during the fellowship period. For the exact eligibility of the post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly fellowship is Rs. 37,000/- per month + HRA. The notice prints "(31-03-2027)" beside the fellowship, and gives the duration of the position as 4 months. The position is purely temporary, and its continuation is subject to satisfactory performance and review. The selected candidates may get an opportunity to enroll for PhD at NIT Raipur.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Raipur Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
content_sections.text: The notice does not give an email subject line. For any query, contact PI Dr. Chandrashekar Jatoth (Email: [email protected] , Mobile: 8897741409) or Co-PI Dr. Rakesh Tripathi (Email: [email protected] , Mobile: 9340105510). Duly filled application form with self-attested photograph Relevant mark sheets/documents Age proof Research experience certificate (if any) CV List of research publications, if any

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The interview is on 1 December 2026 at 11.30 am onwards at the Department of Information Technology. The notice states that an online interview is permissible. No TA/DA is permissible for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Raipur JRF post?
faq.answer: The application must be emailed on or before 27/11/2026 to [email protected].

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for the NIT Raipur JRF post?
faq.answer: A Graduate/Post graduate Degree in Computer Sc. & Engg./ Information Technology/ Electronics/ AI/Data Science or equivalent with minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA (out of 10).

faq.question: Q3. What is the fellowship for the NIT Raipur JRF?
faq.answer: The consolidated fellowship is Rs. 37,000/- per month + HRA.

faq.question: Q4. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs. 37,000 fellowship?
faq.answer: The notice prints the fellowship as Rs. 37,000/- per month + HRA. It does not give an HRA amount.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the NIT Raipur JRF post?
faq.answer: Email the duly filled application form, relevant mark sheets/documents, age proof, research experience certificate (if any) and CV to [email protected] on or before 27/11/2026.

faq.question: Q6. When is the NIT Raipur JRF interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on December 01, 2026, at 11.30 am onwards, at the Department of Information Technology. An online interview is permissible.

faq.question: Q7. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is permissible for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the NIT Raipur JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary for a duration of 4 months, and continuation is subject to satisfactory performance and review.

faq.question: Q9. Can the JRF enroll for a PhD at NIT Raipur?
faq.answer: The selected candidates may get an opportunity to enroll for PhD at NIT Raipur, according to the notice.

faq.question: Q10. Can a JRF hold another regular or part-time job?
faq.answer: No. Selected candidates will not be permitted to claim any regular/part-time appointments in this Institute or any other organization during this period.
